label: Religious/spiritual discourse
explanation: Fires in passages about God, Jesus, Christ, the Bible, salvation, and sin, with strongest activations on explicit divine names and religious keywords; it also fires weakly on surrounding function words in those passages and at sequence starts because many texts open with religious invocations. It stays silent in ordinary non-religious prose except for low-strength spillover.
